details: Every extension contains the original class, so its VC dimension is at least that of the original class.
proof: If $\mathcal H\subseteq\mathcal E$, every set shattered by $\mathcal H$ is shattered by $\mathcal E$. Taking the minimum over extremal extensions gives the result.
witness_verification: For C_ex, VC=2 and exhaustive enumeration of all same-domain shattering-extremal extensions gives extremal-extension VC dimension 3; sync/verify_extremal_extension_gap.py verifies both.
name: Extremal-Extension VC Dimension / VC Dimension
